content_sections.text: Self-attested photo copy of Matric showing Date of Birth. Self-attested photo copy of essential qualifications and above/diploma/degree. Self-attested photo copy of Experience Certificate issued by the concerned Appointing Authority. Any other document, if required, to be attached at the time of submitting application form. One copy of latest coloured passport size photograph duly self-attested pasted on the application form. Required certificate of employer & copies of all documents duly self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes scrutiny of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on deputation?
faq.answer: The selection on deputation shall be on a temporary basis for a period of one year or till vacancy is filled on regular basis whichever is earlier, provided that the University reserves the right to repatriate any such employee at any stage without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q2. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply separately for more than one post as per their qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach a self-attested photocopy of Matric for Date of Birth, essential qualifications/diploma/degrees, experience certificate issued by the concerned appointing authority, any other required document, a passport size photograph pasted on the application form, and employer certificates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications along with all documents duly self-attested should reach through proper channel via Email at [email protected] on or before 12 November 2026 up to 09:00 PM.
